title: Original Hershey Chocolate Factory
history: Built in 1905, the heart of Milton Hershey's chocolate empire. The smokestacks became a town landmark and could be seen for miles. Workers arrived by trolley each morning to make the chocolate that built a town.

title: Hershey Park Entrance (1907)
history: Originally Hershey Park was a leisure park for factory workers, opened in 1907 with a pavilion. Milton Hershey believed happy workers made better chocolate. What started as a picnic ground grew into the amusement park we know today.

title: High Point Mansion - Milton Hershey's Home
history: Completed in 1908, this is where Milton and Catherine Hershey entertained guests and planned the town. From this hilltop they could overlook the factory, the town, and the school they founded for orphaned boys.

title: Hershey Chocolate World original site / Community Building
history: The Community Building opened in 1932 as the social heart of Hershey. It housed a theater, library, hospital, and school. The original Chocolate World welcome center was nearby, introducing visitors to the story of chocolate.
